Details: what was checked

Each step below read one public file from this library. The long codes are fingerprints: if a file changes, its fingerprint changes, and the step after it no longer matches.

    Templates and prototypes, not finished products. Sample data only. Test and fit anything you build before real use.

    More: what this is, and how it is supported

    How a prototype is made. Each agent in this library is a public template for one industry use case. A fitted prototype comes from three layers: an industry template, a product template for where it runs, and your own specifics on top of both.

    Templates, not finished products. The agents in this library should be seen as templates from which you inherit your individual solution, or as inspiration for implementing your own.

    Support. Although the underlying features and components used to build these agents are fully supported (such as Copilot Studio, Power Automate and Dataverse), the library itself represents an example implementation of these features. Our customers, partners, and community can use and customize these features to implement capabilities in their organizations.

    Microsoft Support won't help you with issues related to the library, but they will help with related, underlying platform and feature issues. For the library, report an issue on GitHub.

    Using and copying. The library is open source under the MIT License. Keep the copyright and license notice with what you copy.
